description: Inventory, Sales, Purchasing, Suppliers, and Customers pages. These five pages are all data-table CRUD pages following the same pattern: load from mock/Supabase, render .results-table, open Modal for add/edit. Depends on FEAT-001 (CSS, stores, UI primitives). Independent of FEAT-002 (no page depends on another page's component). Independent of FEAT-004.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001 findings before starting. Verify FEAT-001 is completed by checking that npm run build passes.

Write src/pages/Inventory.jsx. State: products (from mock or Supabase), suppliers (for dropdown), activeTab ('all'), searchQuery, showModal (false), editingProduct (null), showStockModal (false), page (1). Tab bar: All | Low Stock | Expiring Soon. Filter products by tab: Low Stock = quantity<=reorder_level, Expiring Soon = expiry_date within 90 days from today. Apply searchQuery filter on name+sku+category. Render .results-table with columns: SKU, Name, Category (Badge), Unit, Pack Size, Qty (red if low), Reorder Level, Cost N, Price N, Supplier, Expiry (warn color if within 90 days), Actions (Edit/Stock/Delete buttons). Pagination using Pagination component (20 per page). Add Product button (admin/manager only) as .btn in page header. Export button as .btn-ghost calls exportToExcel(products) using xlsx library -- creates workbook with product data. Add/Edit Product Modal (size='lg'): form with all fields: name (required), category select (Vet Drug/Agro Chemical/Equipment/Consumable), sub_category text, sku with 'Auto-generate' button (generates VD-NNN/AC-NNN/EQ-NNN/CO-NNN based on category and existing count+1), unit select (bottle/sachet/litre/kg/carton/vial/piece), pack_size, quantity (number, min 0), reorder_level (number, min 0), cost_price (number), selling_price (number), supplier_id select from suppliers list, batch_number, expiry_date date input, notes textarea. Save creates/updates product (mock: push to mockProducts or update in place; Supabase: insert/update products table). Delete: confirm dialog then remove. Stock Adjustment Modal (size='sm'): type (Add Stock/Remove Stock), quantity (number), reason (text required). On save: update product quantity, create stock_movement entry {product_id, type: add->in/remove->out, quantity, reason, user_id}.

Write src/pages/Sales.jsx. State: sales (from mock), saleItems (from mock), suppliers, activeFilter ('all'), searchQuery, dateFrom, dateTo, paymentFilter ('all'), expandedSaleId (null), page. Filter sales by: searchQuery on receipt_id+customer_name, dateFrom/dateTo on created_at, paymentFilter on payment_method. Cashier role: only show sales where user_id=authStore.user.id (filter mockSales by demo-admin id for demo). Render .results-table: Receipt ID (monospace 11px), Date, Customer, Items count, Total (N formatted), Payment Badge, Cashier, Status Badge, Actions. On row click toggle expandedSaleId -- expanded row shows nested items table (product_name, qty, unit_price, line_total) as a tr with td colSpan=9 containing div.card inner table. Void button (admin only): confirm then set status='voided' (style row with opacity:0.6 strike-through receipt_id). Export button: export filtered sales to xlsx. Filter controls: search input, date range (two date inputs), payment method select.

Write src/pages/Purchasing.jsx. State: purchases (from mock), products (for line items), suppliers, showModal (false), editingPO (null), showReceiveModal (false), receivingPO (null), page. Table columns: PO Number, Supplier, Date, Items count, Total N, Status Badge (Draft=info/Ordered=warn/Received=ok/Cancelled=danger), Actions (Receive/Edit/Delete -- Receive only shown for Ordered status, admin/manager). Add PO Modal (size='lg'): supplier select, status select, date input, line items section -- dynamic rows with product select + quantity input + cost_price input (auto-fills from product.cost_price) + line total display + remove row button + Add Item button. Total auto-calculates. Save: push to mockPurchases and mockPurchaseItems (or Supabase insert). Receive PO Modal (size='md'): shows PO items, confirm receipt date, on confirm: update each product quantity += purchase_item.quantity, create stock_movement entries type='in' reference_id=po_number, update purchase status to 'Received'.

Write src/pages/Suppliers.jsx. State: suppliers (from mock), products (for counting), showModal (false), editingSupplier (null), searchQuery, page. Table columns: Name, Contact Person, Phone, Email, Address (truncated), Products count (count of mockProducts where supplier_id=supplier.id), Actions (Edit/Delete). Search input filters by name/phone/email. Add/Edit Supplier Modal (size='md'): name (required), contact_name, phone, email, address textarea. Save: push to mockSuppliers or update. Delete: confirm, check if any products use this supplier (warn if so, still allow). EmptyState component when no suppliers.

Write src/pages/Customers.jsx. State: customers (from mock), sales (for totals + last purchase), payments (from mock empty array), showModal (false), editingCustomer (null), showPaymentModal (false), selectedCustomer (null), searchQuery, page. Compute for each customer: totalPurchases = sum of mockSales where customer_name matches customer.name, outstandingCredit = sum of Credit-payment sales not yet paid (use simple calculation: sales with payment_method='Credit' total). Table columns: Name, Phone, Email, Total Purchases N, Outstanding Credit N (warn color if >0), Last Purchase date, Actions (Edit/Record Payment/Delete). Add/Edit Customer Modal (size='sm'): name (required), phone, email, notes. Record Payment Modal (size='sm'): shows customer name, outstanding amount, amount input, note input, date. On save: push to mockCustomerPayments, reduce outstanding credit.
Run npm run build from /Users/macbookpro/Desktop/ProgrammoCeuticals/agro_shop/ to verify zero errors.
Set FEAT-003 status to 'completed'. Record in findings any patterns that FEAT-004 should use.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory table loads 25 mock products, search filters work, tabs work
Add Product modal opens, all fields render, auto-generate SKU works, save adds to table
Stock adjustment modal updates product quantity in mock data
Export button on Inventory downloads an xlsx file
Sales table loads 15 mock sales, row expand shows sale items
Purchasing table loads 8 mock POs, Receive PO updates product quantities
Suppliers table loads 4 mock suppliers, CRUD modal works
Customers table loads 5 mock customers, payment modal opens
